candidate_grammar.boundary: Every positive finite complete donor-site topology for one retained ligand carrier and one retained central occurrence, tested after seal against all twenty-four registered surfaces from six complete current IUPAC term records.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the literal product of carrier, membership, centre, quantity, chelation, boundary, observation and extension forms; decide all 256 forms solely from admitted coordination identity, exact incidence count, graph connectivity, information retention and source-boundary laws.

excluded_inputs: negative, irrational, imaginary, floating, signed or continuum proof value
imported denticity table, chelate taxonomy, coordination-number rule, geometry catalogue or bonding model
observed IUPAC definition, example or exclusion before prediction seal
selected term, omitted boundary, fitted topology or target-derived correction
intended_certificate: Complete 256-form census, one survivor, depth-independent donor-site successor, first-closure chelation certificate, implementation-distinct reconstruction, capability-closed twenty-four-record IUPAC vector, complete kappa/eta/scope/exclusion retention, omission, centre-mismatch, carrier-collapse and numerical-zero controls.
statement: For one retained ligand carrier attached to one retained central occurrence, denticity is the positive cardinality of its complete distinct donor-site incidences. One site is open; the next separate site is the first successor that closes a carrier-centre path and forces chelation; every later site preserves closure and increments denticity once.
title: Exact ligand denticity and chelation from connected donor-site topology
